cases.reading: The Boston Celtics present a fractured profile where elite defensive metrics and scoring efficiency clash with poor rebounding, turnover control, and free-throw execution. This internal dissonance suggests a team capable of generating points but lacking the structural cohesion to sustain performance, leaving the overall trajectory uncertain despite the available data.
